Data flow — 10 checkpoints

C1 Publication/discovery → C2 Raw collection → C3 Supabase landing → C4 Snapshot/manifest (Supabase → repo) → C5 Health verification → C6 Candidate build/review → C7 Fixture promotion → C8 Sync/validation → C9 Deployment/live artifact.
Each checkpoint shows what it is, when it last ran (real timestamp from artifacts), and why it has its status. Green requires a fresh timestamp — stale data never shows green.

Deployment — live verification

Adjusted curves — pipeline stages

The _adjusted curves (FC Adjusted, USAT Adjusted, FP Adjusted, CBS Adjusted) flow through 5 stages: A1 Input data → A2 Fit executed → A3 Sections baked → A4 Synced to dist → A5 Live.
Each stage must run after the previous one. If any stage is stale, the curves pause on the live dashboard. Green requires the stage timestamp to be after the previous stage.

Source fidelity — pre-indexed values

The pre-indexed (native) numbers are the raw per-game projections before DDF indexing. These are compared directly against the source data — they must match exactly.
The unindexed curves below show the source's raw curve vs. the pipeline's curve that feeds the dashboard. Any divergence means the pipeline is not using the intended source data.

Index math — raw to indexed transformation

How the pre-indexed (native) numbers become the indexed values shown on the dashboard. The transformation is recomputed and compared against the actual indexed numbers — they must match exactly.
Checkpoints generated by pipelines/build_pipeline_checkpoints.py from real artifacts.
